narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The thousandth digit is in the number one thousand, because the number matches the place.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But each number from ten onward adds two or more digits.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The digits pile up much faster, and the slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with the number one thousand; digits per number are shown; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Group the numbers by their number of digits.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Find how far into a group the target falls.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Divide by the digits in each number and use the remainder.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words group by digits appear; the words how far into the group appear; the words divide, remainder appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip says the thousandth digit lies in the number one thousand. Each number has several digits, so we get there much sooner.
